jobs.occupation: Finance Manager - Brussels - International Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly regarded investment organisation active in early-stage technology and innovation. Based in Brussels with close collaboration across international offices, the company combines entrepreneurial spirit with institutional excellence in a modern and globally connected environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage financial operations across investment funds and corporate entities
• Coordinate fund reporting, audits and related financial processes
• Support budgeting, forecasting and financial control activities
• Monitor cash flows, capital calls and investor-related financial operations
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial, regulatory and governance requirements
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external service providers
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of finance processes and controls

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or equivalent
• Minimum 3 years of experience as Finance Manager / Finance Business Partner within venture capital, private equity, investment funds or a VC-backed scale-up environment
• Fluent in English. Fluency in Dutch is a non-mandatory asset.
• Strong understanding of financial reporting, fund structures and control processes
• Demonstrated interest in sectors such as fintech, biotech or technology-driven businesses
• Proactive communicator with a hands-on and detail-oriented mindset

Our client is a recognised player in real estate advisory, specialising in supporting investors and corporates with strategic property transactions. With a solid reputation and deep market expertise, the company combines local market knowledge with a forward-looking investment approach, delivering tailored solutions across multiple asset classes.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Ability to build relationships with senior-level stakeholders
• Proactive, ambitious, and results-driven personality

• Our client is a leading European consumer services organization operating across multiple international markets.
• Recognized for its customer-centric approach, the company continuously invests in service excellence, operational efficiency and process improvement.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor and assess customer interactions and service quality performance to identify trends, gaps and opportunities for improvement.

• Analyze customer feedback, operational performance metrics and quality data to support informed decision-making.

• Collaborate with operational and regional stakeholders to support the implementation of service quality and customer experience initiatives.
• Prepare insightful reports, dashboards and presentations for leadership teams, translating data into clear business recommendations.

• Bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
• 3-5 years of experience in Customer Experience, Service Quality, Operational Excellence, Business Analysis or a related field.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends and transform insights into actionable recommendations.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and reporting tools.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
• Able to work autonomously in a cross-functional environment.
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Flexible to travel across Europe (approximately 20%).

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
• Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
• Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
• International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
• Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.
